data.name: Ezrion
data.gender_notes: Ezrion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Ezra', meaning 'help' or 'aid'. In the Bible, Ezra was a scribe, priest, and leader who led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem to rebuild the Temple. He also brought the Law of Moses with him and helped establish religious practices in the land. The name Ezrion carries the meaning “Help, aid or assistance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ezrion usually hope their child will grow to embody help, aid or assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the assistance and guidance provided by God throughout one's life.

in_greek.name: Εζριων
in_greek.meaning: Εζριων σημαίνει βοήθεια ή υποστήριξη από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Εζριων είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σχετίζεται με τη λέξη עזר, που σημαίνει βοηθώ ή υποστηρίζω. Στο πλαίσιο της χριστιανικής παράδοσης, το Εζριων συνδέεται με την έννοια της βοήθειας ή υποστήριξης από τον Θεό, αντανακλώντας τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού.
